text:
Hey everyone! We're early releasing Blended Web Artists (https://t.co/USIdxo7J9N); a community of 3D artists that are trying to grow the field by making art more interactive rather than just videos/images. Our early release has a variety of different Blender artists' work running in the browser and we hope you check them out!

Many things are still under development, so please feel free to report any issues at any time. We're also looking for others to join or want to submit their work! You can also join our community discord as well if you're interested! https://t.co/CAXSnxfppt
